filters.title: Filters
filters.intro: Rule sets sort one folder of an account: their filters run in order, on new mail, on a schedule or when you say so. Try them with a dry run before letting them act.
filters.runFiltersOn: Run filters is on: enabled rule sets run.
filters.runFiltersOff: Run filters is off: nothing runs on this account until you turn it on.
filters.loadFailed: Could not load the rule sets.
filters.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
filters.schemaFailed: Could not read the filter vocabulary from the server.
filters.foldersFailed: Could not list the account's folders.
filters.foldersUnavailable: The folders could not be listed ({{message}}). Type the path, its parts separated by /.

triggerHints.new_mail: Runs as soon as mail arrives in the folder.
triggerHints.manual: Runs only when you press Run now.

ruleSet.name: Name
ruleSet.folderMissing: Choose the folder this rule set sorts.
ruleSet.starredOnlyHint: Only starred messages are sorted, and each is unstarred once handled: star a message to have it sorted.
ruleSet.enabledHint: Leave it off until a dry run shows its filters do what you want.
ruleSet.confirmRemoval: Remove {{name}} with its filters and run history? The mail stays as it is.
ruleSet.saveFailed: Could not save the rule set.
ruleSet.loadFailed: Could not load the rule set.
ruleSet.notFound: There is no such rule set: it may have been removed.

filter.title: Filters
filter.orderHint: They run top to bottom; disabled ones are skipped.
filter.none: No filters yet: add one, then try it with a dry run.
filter.unreadable: Open it to see the spec.

tree.unknownType: This server does not know “{{type}}”: change it, or edit the filter as JSON.
tree.unknownArg: This value cannot be edited here: edit the filter as JSON.

editor.full: This rule set holds {{max}} filters, the most it can: remove one to add another.
editor.name: Name
editor.jsonHint: The filter spec: {"criterion": …, "action": …}. The server checks it when you save.
editor.jsonNotObject: The spec must be a JSON object.
editor.treeCannotShow: This spec cannot be shown as conditions and actions: {{message}}
editor.incomplete: Fill in every condition and action: a folder or a value is missing.

shape.notSpec: the spec must be an object with “criterion” and “action”.

run.title: Try and run
run.hint: Runs the enabled filters on the folder now, moving and flagging mail for real.
run.blockedRunFilters: Run filters is off for {{id}}: turn it on in Accounts to run this rule set.
run.blockedDisabled: This rule set is disabled: enable it to run it.
run.queued: Run queued: follow it in the run history.
run.blockedNoAccount: The account {{id}} is gone: this rule set cannot run.

dryRun.hint: Shows what each enabled filter would do to the folder's mail now, changing nothing.
dryRun.caveat: Each filter is tried on the folder as it is now, so a message an earlier filter would move can show under a later one too.

report.subject: Subject
report.limited_one: Only the newest message was looked at.
report.limited_other: Only the newest {{count}} messages were looked at.

history.title: Run history
history.loadFailed: Could not load the run history.

filterErrors.runFiltersOff: Run filters is off for this account: turn it on in Accounts first.
filterErrors.ruleSetDisabled: This rule set is disabled: enable it first.
filterErrors.notFound: It is not there any more: it may have been removed meanwhile. Reload the page.
filterErrors.runPending: A run of this rule set is already waiting.
filterErrors.dryRunTimeout: The dry run took too long: try a narrower filter or a smaller folder.
filterErrors.dryRunBusy: Another dry run of yours is still going: wait for it to finish, then try again.
filterErrors.matchTimeout: A filter's pattern took too long on a message, so the run stopped: simplify the pattern (nested repeats such as (a+)+ are the usual cause).
filterErrors.tooManyFilters: A rule set holds at most {{max}} filters: remove one to add another.
filterErrors.invalidOrder: The filters changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
filterErrors.invalidRuleSet: A scheduled rule set needs an interval in minutes; the other triggers take none.
filterErrors.accountNotFound: The rule set's account is gone.
filterErrors.interrupted: The run was cut short and did not finish.
filterErrors.runFailed: The run stopped on an unexpected error ({{message}}).
